title: Exploring Jailbreak Vulnerability Across Depth-Based Dynamic Inference in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.15207v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to be computationally expensive and vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, in which adversarial prompts bypass safety alignment and induce harmful responses. To address this inefficiency, a range of techniques have been proposed to enable efficient LLM inference. Depth-based dynamic inference has demonstrated promising results by enabling outputs to be generated from intermediate layers. It offers the flexibility to adjust model behavior based on the available resource budget. However, how this flexibility affects the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks remains unexplored. In this paper, we address this gap via a comprehensive investigation into the impact of depth-based dynamic inference on the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks. translated_title: 探索大语言模型中基于深度的动态推理的越狱漏洞
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已被证明计算成本高昂且容易受到越狱攻击，即对抗性提示可以绕过安全对齐并诱导产生有害响应。为了解决这种低效问题，研究者提出了一系列技术以实现高效的大语言模型推理。基于深度的动态推理通过允许从中间层生成输出，已展现出令人鼓舞的效果，它提供了根据可用资源预算灵活调整模型行为的能力。然而，这种灵活性如何影响大语言模型对越狱攻击的鲁棒性仍尚未被探索。在本文中，我们通过对基于深度的动态推理对大语言模型对抗越狱攻击鲁棒性的影响进行全面研究来填补这一空白。具体而言，我们得出以下关键观察：1) 浅层退出始终比深层退出对越狱攻击更具鲁棒性；2) 退出深度……
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了基于深度的动态推理对大语言模型越狱鲁棒性的影响，发现浅层退出始终比深层退出对越狱攻击更具鲁棒性，揭示了动态推理灵活性所带来的安全风险。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first comprehensive investigation into how depth-based dynamic inference affects the jailbreak robustness of LLMs, revealing that shallow exits are consistently more robust to jailbreak attacks than deeper ones, thereby exposing the security risks introduced by the flexibility of dynamic inference.
